-- ========================================================
-- 🌌 SKYBOX LAYERS [UPDATE 3]
-- 🛠️ SUPPORT: Delta Executor & Mobile/PC Executors
-- 📝 FEATURES: Loading Screen, 15 Layers, Smooth Echo, Space Debris
-- ========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ==========================================
-- 1. GUI PROTECTOR & SETUP
-- ==========================================
local function getGuiParent()
    local success, hui = pcall(function() return gethui() end)
    if success and hui then return hui end
    local success2, cgui = pcall(function() return CoreGui end)
    if success2 and cgui then return cgui end
    return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "SkyboxLayersUpdate3"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = getGuiParent()

-- ==========================================
-- 2. SISTEM LOADING GUI
-- ==========================================
local LoadingFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
LoadingFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
LoadingFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
LoadingFrame.ZIndex = 999
LoadingFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local LoadingTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LoadingTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
LoadingTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoadingTitle.Text = "Skybox Layers"
LoadingTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
LoadingTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
LoadingTitle.TextSize = 40
LoadingTitle.ZIndex = 1000
LoadingTitle.Parent = LoadingFrame

-- Animasi Loading
task.wait(1)
TweenService:Create(LoadingTitle, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {TextSize = 50, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 255)}):Play()
task.wait(2)
TweenService:Create(LoadingFrame, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
TweenService:Create(LoadingTitle, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
task.delay(1, function() LoadingFrame:Destroy() end)

-- ==========================================
-- 3. MAIN GUI & MAP DISTANCE TRACKER
-- ==========================================
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.4, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2
MainFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)

Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

Title.TextSize = 13

local FlyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

FlyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.25, 0)
FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
FlyBtn.Text = "START ASCEND (SIT)"
FlyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FlyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
FlyBtn.TextSize = 14

local SpeedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SpeedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20)
SpeedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.55, 0)
SpeedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SpeedLabel.Text = "Set Speed (10 - 500k):"
SpeedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
SpeedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
SpeedLabel.TextSize = 14
SpeedLabel.Parent = MainFrame

local SpeedBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
SpeedBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
SpeedBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.7, 0)
SpeedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50)
SpeedBox.Text = "5000"
SpeedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
SpeedBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
SpeedBox.TextSize = 18
SpeedBox.Parent = MainFrame

-- Tracker Map GUI
local TrackerFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
TrackerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 110)
TrackerFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -320, 0.05, 0)
TrackerFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
TrackerFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2
TrackerFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TrackerFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local TrackerTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TrackerTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
TrackerTitle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
TrackerTitle.Text = "📍 MAP & DISTANCE"
TrackerTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TrackerTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TrackerTitle.TextSize = 13
TrackerTitle.Parent = TrackerFrame

local DistanceLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
DistanceLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
DistanceLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 30)
DistanceLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
DistanceLabel.Text = "Altitude: 0 Studs"
DistanceLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
DistanceLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
DistanceLabel.TextSize = 16
DistanceLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
DistanceLabel.Parent = TrackerFrame

local LayerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LayerLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
LayerLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 60)
LayerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LayerLabel.Text = "Zone: Ground"
LayerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
LayerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
LayerLabel.TextSize = 15
LayerLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
LayerLabel.Parent = TrackerFrame

local ProgressBG = Instance.new("Frame")
ProgressBG.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 8)
ProgressBG.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 95)
ProgressBG.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
ProgressBG.BorderSizePixel = 0
ProgressBG.Parent = TrackerFrame

local ProgressBar = Instance.new("Frame")
ProgressBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
ProgressBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
ProgressBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
ProgressBar.Parent = ProgressBG

-- Sistem Drag UI
local function makeDraggable(frame, handle)
    local dragStart, startPos, dragging
    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true; dragStart = input.Position; startPos = frame.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function() if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end)
        end
    end)
    game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
end
makeDraggable(MainFrame, Title)
makeDraggable(TrackerFrame, TrackerTitle)

-- ==========================================
-- 4. AUDIO ENGINE (GEMA HALUS)
-- ==========================================
local SGroup = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
SGroup.Name = "SkyboxAudio"
SGroup.Parent = SoundService

local Reverb = Instance.new("ReverbSoundEffect")
Reverb.DecayTime = 2.5 -- Gema panjang tapi halus
Reverb.Density = 0.8
Reverb.Diffusion = 0.8
Reverb.Parent = SGroup

local Echo = Instance.new("EchoSoundEffect")
Echo.Delay = 0.6
Echo.Feedback = 0.2 -- Feedback rendah agar tidak berisik
Echo.WetLevel = -0.1
Echo.Parent = SGroup

local BGSound = Instance.new("Sound")
BGSound.SoundGroup = SGroup
BGSound.Volume = 0.7
BGSound.Looped = true
BGSound.Parent = SoundService

-- ==========================================
-- 5. LIGHTING & DATABASE LAYERS
-- ==========================================
for _, obj in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
    if obj:IsA("Sky") or obj:IsA("Atmosphere") or obj:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then obj:Destroy() end
end
Lighting.FogEnd = 1000000

local currentSky = Instance.new("Sky")
currentSky.Name = "SkyboxLayer"
currentSky.Parent = Lighting

local CC = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
CC.Parent = Lighting

local function setSkyTexture(id)
    local tex = id and ("rbxassetid://" .. id) or ""
    currentSky.SkyboxBk = tex; currentSky.SkyboxDn = tex
    currentSky.SkyboxFt = tex; currentSky.SkyboxLf = tex
    currentSky.SkyboxRt = tex; currentSky.SkyboxUp = tex
end

local LAYERS = {
    {name="Ground", studs=0, sky=nil, sound=nil, pitch=1, effect="none"},
    {name="1. Null Zone", studs=50000, sky=nil, sound=nil, pitch=1, effect="flicker"},
    {name="2. Black Box", studs=1000000, sky="1864839162", sound="9125603749", pitch=1, effect="none"},
    {name="3. Color Box", studs=1500000, sky="76584711398016", sound="103640130374819", pitch=1, effect="rgb"},
    {name="4. Glitch Box", studs=2000000, sky="678675390", sound="74461673136220", pitch=1, effect="glitch"},
    {name="5. Red Box", studs=5000000, sky="136055162054954", sound="1844251170", pitch=1, effect="red"},
    {name="6. Gall Box", studs=10000000, sky="348361280", sound="140449240163331", pitch=1, effect="green"},
    {name="7. Fritch Box", studs=15000000, sky="14201658516", sound="133054925243074", pitch=1, effect="none"},
    {name="8. True Void Box", studs=25000000, sky="1864839162", sound=nil, pitch=1, effect="dark"},
    {name="9. Noise Box", studs=35000000, sky="132436343179109", sound="9043345732", pitch=10, effect="noise"},
    {name="10. Blue Box", studs=50000000, sky="1864839162", sound="105560583824086", pitch=1, effect="blue"},
    {name="11. Scream Box", studs=65000000, sky="136055162054954", sound=nil, pitch=1, effect="darkred"},
    {name="12. White Box", studs=75000000, sky="4604073339", sound="86575433206430", pitch=1, effect="white"},
    {name="13. Time Box", studs=100000000, sky="1276339885", sound="113002664483925", pitch=2, effect="time"},
    {name="14. Space Box", studs=150000000, sky="136402262", sound="139992348741850", pitch=1, effect="space"},
    {name="15. Final Box", studs=250000000, sky="409857582", sound="9125603019", pitch=1, effect="none"}
}

-- ==========================================
-- 6. SPACE ENGINE (LAYER 14) DEBRIS SYSTEM
-- ==========================================
local SpaceFolder = Instance.new("Folder", workspace)
SpaceFolder.Name = "SpaceDebrisEngine"
local DebrisPool = {}

for i = 1, 70 do
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = Vector3.new(math.random(2,8), math.random(2,8), math.random(2,8))
    part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255)
    part.Anchored = true; part.CanCollide = false
    part.Transparency = 1 -- Sembunyikan secara default
    part.Parent = SpaceFolder
    table.insert(DebrisPool, {obj = part, offsetY = math.random(-500, 500)})
end

-- ==========================================
-- 7. CORE ENGINE (FLY & EFFECTS LOOP)
-- ==========================================
local isFlying = false
local flySpeed = 5000
local activeLayerIndex = -1
local effectTimer = 0

FlyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isFlying = not isFlying
    FlyBtn.Text = isFlying and "STOP ASCEND" or "START ASCEND (SIT)"
    FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isFlying and Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
end)

SpeedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local val = tonumber(SpeedBox.Text)
    if val then flySpeed = math.clamp(val, 10, 500000) end
    SpeedBox.Text = tostring(flySpeed)
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp then return end

    -- Update UI Distance
    local altitude = math.floor(hrp.Position.Y)
    DistanceLabel.Text = "Altitude: " .. altitude .. " Studs"
    ProgressBar.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(altitude / 250000000, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)

    -- Fly Logic
    if isFlying then
        if hum then hum.Sit = true end
        for _, p in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end end
        hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, flySpeed * dt, 0)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end

    -- Layer Checker
    local currentIdx = 1
    for i = #LAYERS, 1, -1 do
        if altitude >= LAYERS[i].studs then currentIdx = i break end
    end

    local curData = LAYERS[currentIdx]

    -- Trigger saat ganti layer
    if activeLayerIndex ~= currentIdx then
        activeLayerIndex = currentIdx
        LayerLabel.Text = "Zone: " .. curData.name
        setSkyTexture(curData.sky)

        -- Reset Color Correction
        CC.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        if curData.effect == "red" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
        elseif curData.effect == "green" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
        elseif curData.effect == "blue" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 1)
        elseif curData.effect == "darkred" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(0.3, 0, 0)
        elseif curData.effect == "dark" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(0.02, 0.02, 0.02)
        elseif curData.effect == "white" then CC.TintColor = Color3.new(2, 2, 2)
        end

        -- Update Audio System
        if curData.sound then
            BGSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. curData.sound
            BGSound.PlaybackSpeed = curData.pitch
            if not BGSound.IsPlaying then BGSound:Play() end
        else
            BGSound:Stop()
        end

        -- Sembunyikan partikel luar angkasa jika bukan layer 14
        if curData.effect ~= "space" then
            for _, d in pairs(DebrisPool) do d.obj.Transparency = 1 end
        end
    end

    -- =================================
    -- UNIQUE LAYER EFFECTS (REALTIME)
    -- =================================
    effectTimer = effectTimer + dt

    if curData.effect == "flicker" then
        CC.TintColor = (math.floor(effectTimer * 15) % 2 == 0) and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.new(0,0,0)

    elseif curData.effect == "rgb" then
        CC.TintColor = Color3.fromHSV(effectTimer % 3 / 3, 1, 1)

    elseif curData.effect == "glitch" then
        if math.random(1, 10) > 8 then
            setSkyTexture(math.random(1,2) == 1 and "678675390" or "409857582")
        end

    elseif curData.effect == "noise" then
        -- Setiap 1 detik ganti Abu-abu & Merah
        local isRed = math.floor(effectTimer) % 2 == 0
        CC.TintColor = isRed and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)

    elseif curData.effect == "time" then
        -- Sisi skybox berubah-ubah ke {142900882}
        if math.random(1, 30) > 27 then
            local faces = {"SkyboxBk", "SkyboxDn", "SkyboxFt", "SkyboxLf", "SkyboxRt", "SkyboxUp"}
            local targetFace = faces[math.random(1, 6)]
            currentSky[targetFace] = "rbxassetid://142900882"
            
            task.delay(0.15, function()
                if activeLayerIndex == 14 then -- 14 = Time Box (Layer 13 tp index array 14 krn ground)
                    currentSky[targetFace] = "rbxassetid://1276339885"
                end
            end)
        end

    elseif curData.effect == "space" then
        -- Space Box Debris: Part berterbangan ke bawah (Ilusi Player naik)
        for _, d in pairs(DebrisPool) do
            d.obj.Transparency = 0.2
            -- Partikel jatuh sesuai dengan kecepatan terbang player
            d.offsetY = d.offsetY - (math.clamp(flySpeed, 100, 2000) * dt)
            
            -- Jika part sudah menjauh 500 stud di bawah player, spawn kembali di atas
            if d.offsetY < -500 then
                d.offsetY = 500 + math.random(0, 300)
                d.obj.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-300, 300), d.offsetY, math.random(-300, 300))
            else
                -- Turunkan Y secara halus
                d.obj.CFrame = CFrame.new(d.obj.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y + d.offsetY, d.obj.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(d.offsetY/10, d.offsetY/10, 0)
            end
        end
    end
end)
